## ownership_stakes

Effective-dated fractional ownership. ★ load-bearing.

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Keys |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | INTEGER | no |  | PK |
| `account_id` | INTEGER | no |  | FK → `accounts.id` ON DELETE CASCADE |
| `owner_user_id` | INTEGER | no |  | FK → `users.id` ON DELETE RESTRICT |
| `percentage` | NUMERIC(5, 2) | no |  |  |
| `effective_from` | DATE | no |  |  |
| `effective_to` | DATE | yes |  |  |

- CHECK `ck_stakes_date_order`: `effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to > effective_from`

- INDEX `ix_ownership_stakes_owner_user_id`: (owner_user_id)
- INDEX `ix_stakes_account_effective`: (account_id, effective_from)
